claims.claim_text: The Board oversees climate-related risks and opportunities.
claims.support_notes: Identifies the governance body responsible for oversight, but does not describe how responsibilities are reflected in terms of reference/mandates/role descriptions/policies.
No underlying governance record or board composition evidence provided in the excerpt.

claims.claim_text: Across the reported governance records, the Board held 4, 7 and 8 full Board meetings per year.
claims.support_notes: Provides meeting frequency but does not specify the reporting periods/years or link explicitly to how often the Board is informed about climate-related risks/opportunities.

claims.claim_text: Across the reported governance records, climate-related matters were included on the Board agenda 69.8% of the time.
claims.support_notes: Supports that climate matters are regularly considered, but lacks definition of denominator/timeframe and underlying agenda/minutes evidence in the excerpt.

claims.claim_text: Board minutes evidence that Board discussions on climate-related matters include transition plan review, scenario analysis, TCFD review, net zero progress, carbon credit approval and executive remuneration ESG KPIs.
evidence_sources: Draft report text: Governance 1.1 (asserted 'Board minutes evidence')
claims.support_notes: Lists matters reviewed (strategy/targets/remuneration-related), but the actual minutes are not provided; also does not address trade-offs.

claims.claim_text: Climate risk reporting is provided to the Board on a semi-annual basis.
claims.support_notes: Directly addresses frequency of being informed, but does not describe content, format, or evidence of the reporting cadence.

claims.claim_text: An ESG committee is in place.
claims.support_notes: Identifies a committee but does not specify its mandate/terms of reference or explicit climate oversight responsibilities.

claims.claim_text: Across the reported governance records, the ESG committee met 5, 6 and 7 times per year.
claims.support_notes: Meeting frequency stated without periods/years or evidence; also not explicitly tied to climate reporting/oversight cadence.

claims.claim_text: Climate-related considerations are incorporated into decisions on major transactions through a climate check for major transactions.
claims.support_notes: Addresses consideration in major transactions, but does not describe how the Board oversees this control, how it operates, scope, thresholds, or evidence of application.

claims.claim_text: The Board’s oversight of climate-related performance is linked to remuneration through climate-related components of executive remuneration.
claims.support_notes: States linkage to remuneration but does not describe governance oversight of target-setting/monitoring or the specific metrics/targets used.

claims.claim_text: Across the reported governance records, the proportion of executive remuneration linked to climate-related factors was 8.7%, 15.3% and 15.1%.
claims.support_notes: Quantifies remuneration linkage but lacks timeframe, definition of 'climate-related factors', and supporting remuneration policy/KPI documentation.

claims.claim_text: Management oversight is delegated to a management-level committee.
claims.support_notes: States delegation to a committee but does not explain how oversight is exercised over that committee.

claims.claim_text: Across the reported governance records, the management committee identified for this purpose is recorded as Group Sustainability Committee, ESG Executive Committee, and Climate Risk Management Committee.
claims.support_notes: Identifies possible committees but is ambiguous (multiple names) and does not clarify which committee applies in which period/entity or how oversight is exercised.

claims.claim_text: Climate-related risk management is integrated into enterprise risk management (ERM).
claims.support_notes: Indicates integration with internal functions (ERM) but does not describe specific controls/procedures or how integration operates.
Addresses skills/competencies determination at a high level but does not explain the method/criteria for assessing expertise.

claims.claim_text: Across the reported governance records, 33.5%, 35.5% and 37.5% of the Board was identified as having climate expertise.
claims.support_notes: Quantifies expertise but lacks timeframe and definition/assessment basis for 'climate expertise'.

claims.claim_text: A skills development programme is in place.
claims.support_notes: Supports that competencies will be developed, but provides no details on programme scope, participation, or evidence.

claims.claim_text: To avoid unnecessary duplication, governance disclosures for climate-related risks and opportunities are presented together with broader sustainability-related governance where these are managed on an integrated basis.
claims.support_notes: Presentation approach statement; no external requirement mapping provided in the supplied requirement list.
